verses.text: If one of you has a complaint against another believer, how dare you take it to court before people who do not know God, instead of before God's people?
Do you not know that God's people will judge the world? And if you will judge the world, can you not settle even small matters?
Do you not know that we will judge angels? So surely we can judge the things of this life!
So if you have such cases, why do you ask people who count for nothing in the church to judge them?
I say this to shame you. Is there no one among you wise enough to settle a quarrel between believers?
Instead, one believer takes another to court, and in front of unbelievers!
Having court cases against each other already means you have failed. Why not rather be treated wrongly? Why not rather be cheated?
Instead, you yourselves do wrong and cheat, and you do it to your own brothers and sisters.

Do you not know that people who do wrong will not receive God's kingdom? Do not be fooled. People who commit sexual sin, who worship idols, who are unfaithful in marriage, or men who have sex with men,
thieves, greedy people, drunkards, people who speak evil of others, and cheats will not receive God's kingdom.
Some of you used to be like that. But you were washed clean. You were made holy. You were made right with God in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ and by the Spirit of our God.
You say, "I am allowed to do anything." But not everything is good for you. "I am allowed to do anything," but I will not let anything control me.
You say, "Food is for the stomach, and the stomach is for food." But God will destroy them both. The body is not for sexual sin. It is for the Lord, and the Lord is for the body.
God raised the Lord from the dead, and he will raise us too by his power.
Do you not know that your bodies are parts of Christ's body? So should I take parts of Christ's body and join them to a prostitute? Never!
Do you not know that a man who joins himself to a prostitute becomes one body with her? For the Scriptures say, "The two will become one."
But whoever joins himself to the Lord becomes one with him in spirit.
Run away from sexual sin! Every other sin a person commits is outside the body. But whoever commits sexual sin sins against their own body.
Do you not know that your body is a temple of the Holy Spirit, who lives in you and was given to you by God? You do not belong to yourselves.
God bought you at a high price. So honour God with your body.
